decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the removal of the existing windows and the replacement with double glazing windows and removal of the existing asbestos backed cladding with new at the Ivybridge Estate, 82-120 Mogden Lane because of the position, design and appearance of the building, would be acceptable having due 
regard for the site characteristics of  this block of flats and would not be 
detrimental to its appearance  and the character of the street scene or 
to the amenities nearby properties.  The development is in accordance with the UDP policies  ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and  H 6.1  (Housing Improvements) of The 
London Borough of Hounslow UDP,  Adopted December 2003
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.
description: Removal of the existing windows, replace with double-glazed windows and removal of the existing asbestos backed cladding with new.
